Scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a historical time period with a second “time of” phrase; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
Run 2: 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines two time expressions: 古代 already names a time period, while 的时候 also means “at the time of.” [vocab list]
Run 3: 古代的时候：在古代，The original repeats the time meaning because 古代 already refers to a historical time period. [vocab list]

output.reason: All runs flag the same phrase and suggest the same replacement, but the teacher did not treat 古代的时候 as an error.
